_comment: Every threshold the diagnosis uses, with its reason. Edit here, not in code.

nearDupDeltaE.why: CIEDE2000 2.0: distinguishable only side by side. 1.0 is the just-noticeable difference.

twinDeltaE.why: Below the just-noticeable difference the two colors are the same color.

sigSprawl.why: Ad-hoc looks per component type: 3 already means the base component is being bypassed; 6 means there is no base.

achromaticSprawl.why: A deliberate gray ramp has 5–8 steps; beyond 15 nobody chose them.

hardcodeBands.why: Share of occurrences that go through a token: ≥85% working system, 50–85% partial, 20–50% decorative, <20% none (v1 bands).

hardcodeMinOccurrences.why: Below 10 occurrences a ratio is noise.

spacingSteps.why: Try 8, then 4, then 2; a step is the scale when 75% of distinct values land on it.

siblingMinDiffPx.why: Under 2px is sub-pixel on most displays.

siblingHighGroups.why: Five mismatched rows is a pattern, not an accident.

ratioTolerance.why: Radius/height ratio within 0.05 of the project's own modal ratio reads as the same shape.

repeatInlineMin.why: Three identical raw elements is the point where a component would have paid off.

screensHigh.why: A defect on three or more screens is high severity regardless of count.

severityWeight.why: Priority = weight × screens ÷ occurrences (cost proxy); used for ordering only.
